description: This file defines a REST API controller class InstallationDatabaseUserAPI which handles HTTP POST requests to create a database user during the installation process of the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract base controller and uses utility classes for setup tasks.

classes.name: InstallationDatabaseUserAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for handling database user creation during system installation.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a database user via AppSetupUtility.
